meta.titleHome: Pousada Recanto do Park | Penha, Santa Catarina
meta.descriptionHome: Cozy lodging in Penha, Brazil, just minutes from Beto Carrero World and the best beaches in the region. Book your stay.
meta.descriptionAccommodations: Discover the rooms and suites at Pousada Recanto do Park, in Penha, Brazil.

hero.title: Your retreat between the park and the sea
hero.subtitle: Five minutes from Beto Carrero World and steps from Gravatá Beach. Comfort, breakfast included and on-site parking for the whole family.

essentialInfo.title: What to know before you arrive
essentialInfo.subtitle: A quick summary to help you plan your trip to Pousada Recanto do Park.

about.title: Rest and adventure, side by side
about.body: Pousada Recanto do Park is the ideal base for those coming to experience Beto Carrero World and unwind at Gravatá Beach. Comfortable suites, breakfast included, on-site parking and a team that truly knows the region. Everything for your family to enjoy Penha with peace of mind.

location.title: Between the park and the sea
location.parkDescription: Latin America's largest theme park, right around the corner.
location.beachDescription: Rocky headlands, open sea and wide sand. And best of all: pet-friendly, your dog is welcome.
location.carouselSubtitle: A glimpse of what you'll find near the pousada, at Gravatá Beach.
